headline: **MLB Daily Recap**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels fell short in Baltimore, losing 1-3 to the Orioles. Tyler O'Neill led the Angels' offense with a home run, while Cade Povich earned the win for the Orioles with 6.0 innings of scoreless relief.

Injuries continue to impact teams across the league. The Cincinnati Reds placed Hunter Greene on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow soreness. The Los Angeles Angels also placed Sam Bachman on the 15-day injured list with right forearm radial nerve inflammation. The Toronto Blue Jays transferred Patrick Corbin to the 60-day injured list with a left teres major strain, and placed Trey Yesavage on the 15-day injured list with left knee inflammation. The Washington Nationals placed James Wood on the 10-day injured list with a left oblique strain. The Athletics placed Jeffrey Springs on the 15-day injured list with right hip discomfort and Nick Kurtz on the 10-day injured list with a strained right thumb. The Chicago Cubs placed Clay Holmes on the 60-day injured list.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place. The Athletics acquired Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee. The Miami Marlins also acquired Victor Vodnik from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Connor Norby and Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Angels Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels suffered a 1-3 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, unable to overcome the Orioles' strong performance. Tyler O'Neill led the Angels' offense with a home run, while Cade Povich earned the win for the Orioles with 6.0 innings of scoreless relief.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Guardians 6-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 6-2 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Sean Manaea earning the win after 6.0 innings pitched. Luis Torrens led the Mets' offense with a 3-hit, 4-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Edge Athletics in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 5-4 victory over the Athletics, with Julian Garcia earning the win. Brady Singer led the Athletics' pitching effort, throwing 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall to Phillies in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals suffered a 0-5 loss to the Philadelphia Phillies, marking a disappointing end to the game. Jesús Luzardo led the Phillies to victory, pitching 8.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Astros in Thrilling 5-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a narrow win over the Houston Astros, with Jesús Sánchez and Ernie Clement contributing key hits in the victory. Hunter Brown was a standout on the mound for the Astros, but ultimately fell short in a 5-4 loss.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs edged the Los Angeles Dodgers 7-6 in a close game, handing the Dodgers their loss. Shohei Ohtani and Mookie Betts were among the impact hitters for the Dodgers, while Shota Imanaga stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Reds' Hunter Greene Lands on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Cincinnati Reds right-hander Hunter Greene has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow soreness, effective retroactive to August 2, 2026.

top_news.title: **Athletics Acquire RHP Seth Johnson in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Seth Johnson to the Athletics on August 3, 2026, in exchange for RF Colby Thomas.
